veio.guide.title: Veio Field Guide
veio.guide.welcome: The village needs a workshop. Follow the objective above the hotbar. The workbook is an optional reference; tutorial progress follows working machines.
veio.componenthelp.copper_plate: Press raw copper. Used for gears and wiring.
veio.componenthelp.iron_plate: Press raw iron. Used for frames and steel.
veio.componenthelp.gear: Two copper plates in an assembler. Starts the upgrades.
veio.componenthelp.frame: Iron plate in a cutter. Used for mechanical modules.
veio.componenthelp.module: Frame and gear in an integrator. Used for expansion.
veio.componenthelp.steel_plate: Two iron plates and coal in an alloy furnace.
veio.componenthelp.wire: A copper plate in a cutter makes two. Used for circuits and cables.
veio.componenthelp.silicon: Nether quartz in a crusher. Used for circuits.
veio.componenthelp.circuit: Two copper wiring and one silicon in a circuit assembler.
veio.guide.page.02:
Technical reference

To learn automation, use Your first workshop: book + cobblestone.

The Factory board tracks phases and deliveries. Find machines, power, logistics and recipes here.
veio.guide.page.03:
When a machine stops

No power: check fuel and cables.

No ore: check the block underneath.

Missing material: inspect the slots.

Output full: make room downstream.
veio.guide.page.04:
Controls and help

Empty hand + right-click opens the panel.

Wrench + right-click turns it.

Hover over ? or an empty slot for help.

Powered redstone pauses production.
veio.guide.page.05:
Your checklist

Open Advancements and find First requests. Milestones track obtained materials.

Pick up products to mark progress.

Inspect machine panels to confirm operation.
veio.guide.page.06:
Poles and wires

Each pole powers machines within 2 blocks (steel: 3) and links to nearby poles.

Wood: 8-block wire, 120 FE/t.
Steel: 16-block wire, 400 FE/t.

Starving far away? The wire is the limit.
veio.guide.page.07:
Pollution

Working machines pollute their chunk; the panel shows how much per minute. It spreads and slowly fades.

Harvested crops absorb it. Efficiency modules halve it.
veio.guide.page.08:
Raiders

Chat warns a day ahead. The next night they come with a raid horn, for you and the villagers.

Four hits stop a machine or kill a villager. Walls, a sword, barracks and Tesla towers.
veio.guide.page.09:
Modules

Right-click a machine to install one. Sneak with the wrench to remove it.

Speed: more output, power and pollution.
Efficiency: less power and pollution.
Productivity: +20% products.
veio.guide.page.10:
Factory and world

Harvester: build the farm around it and belt the crops away.

Tesla tower: guards the base at night. Pair solar with batteries.

Monster bones become bone meal in the crusher.
veio.guide.page.11:
Trade

After the village project, the hub keeps exporting: 4 circuits and 4 steel plates become 4 emeralds and 2 experience bottles.
veio.guide.page.12:
Optional beacon

After the village project, empty the hub inputs. Put 1 Nether star in input 1 first, then 48 circuits in input 2.

Receive 1 beacon and 2 Mk.II extractors. Clear outputs before returning to exports.
veio.guide.page.13:
Production ladder

Each phase fixes one bottleneck and reveals the next: vein, power, transport.

Connected veins pay: 7+ blocks double, 16+ quadruple. Normal extractor = 30/min = one press.

The worker village

Hired villagers work for you: fields, animals, machines, storage and a control center.

It is all in the Worker Village Guide, given when you obtain a post. Book + wheat craft another.
veio.guide.page.17:
Conveyor turns

Connect one incoming and one outgoing belt. The corner adjusts automatically.

At junctions, use the wrench to lock the outlet. Sneak with it to restore automatic routing.
veio.guide.page.18:
Up and down

Place belts on stair-stepped blocks, one block of height per step.

The lower belt becomes a ramp. Leave headroom.

Machines, splitters and mergers connect at the same height.
veio.guide.page.19:
Logistics network

Belts carry over distance. Arms link chests and machines. Mergers join; splitters distribute.

Use fast belts after merging.

Set a filter

Sneak and use an item on an arm or splitter to copy its filter. The sample is kept.

Sneak with an empty hand to clear. See the icon on the block.
veio.guide.page.21:
Priorities

Sneak with a wrench on a splitter or merger: balanced, left/A, right/B.

Priority falls back if needed. Sorting filters never mix lanes.

Redstone pauses arms and belts. Belts respond within 8 ticks.

Panels show items/min. A sorting splitter sends matching left, other right.

veio.village.page.02:
The worker village

You start at the center of a village. Villagers start working for you, and the village grows with the factory.

Follow the steps in order. The Worker Village advancement tab tracks progress.
veio.village.page.03:
1. First worker

Farmhand post near crops and villagers.

Bread in the left slot; click the post with an emerald.

The villager harvests and brings the crop back.
veio.village.page.04:
2. Mark the field

Place the field marker at the center of the field, with water nearby.

Posts within 3 blocks of the border work the whole area: till, plant and harvest.

Seed in the marker: only that is planted.
veio.village.page.05:
3. Pens

Fence the animals and put the pen marker in the middle. A nearby shepherd post tends them.

Feed in the marker sets the pen: carrots for pigs, seeds for chickens, wheat for cows and sheep.
veio.village.page.06:
4. Barn and silo

The barn keeps any item; the silo, grain and food.

Hoppers insert and extract. With a foreman nearby, surplus goes there by itself.
veio.village.page.07:
5. Haulers

The hauler post feeds machines within 6 blocks from the left slots and brings products to the right.

It leaves belts alone.
veio.village.page.08:
6. Foreman and queue

The foreman desk manages 6 posts within 12 blocks: brings food and rehires with emeralds.

It queues deliveries between posts, machines and storage, done by haulers.
veio.village.page.09:
7. Control center

Hire an administrator. The panel shows workers, waits, zones, storage and goals.

Item in a goal slot: x16 stored. Book on the center: report. Spawn moves to the center.
veio.village.page.10:
Grow the zones

Emerald on the marker unlocks the next level:
13x13: 8 emer., 32 tasks, 6 villagers
17x17: 16, 128, 12
21x21: 32, 384, 20

The wrench picks the size among unlocked ones.
veio.village.page.11:
The village grows

Cap: 30 villagers, +3 per staffed post, +5 per zone level, +2 per storage, +20 for the control center. Max 150.

Each one needs a bed: with no free bed, nobody is born.
veio.village.page.12:
On your network

Host: Esc, Open to LAN, Start LAN World.

Join: same Wi-Fi, Multiplayer; the world shows in the list. Same Veio version.

The machines are the host's.
veio.village.page.13:
When a villager stops

No food: add bread.
Missing: bring them back or dismiss (sneak + wrench).
Path blocked: clear the way.
Output full: empty it or use a barn.
Hover over the panel status for tips.

veio.onboarding.hint.0: Village workshop: we need parts and production that keeps going while you explore. First, place a generator. Recipe: furnace + iron ingot + copper ingot. Your objective stays above the hotbar. /veiotutorial ocultar hides it; mostrar restores it.
veio.onboarding.hint.1: Now make a press: copper ingot + iron ingot + piston + smooth stone. Connect touching generator > cable > press. Cable: copper + stick makes 16. Fuel the generator with coal. The goal advances when the press actually receives power.
veio.onboarding.hint.2: Power confirmed. Open the press with an empty hand: put RAW copper in the left input. Watch progress and collect plates on the right. Produce 4 fresh plates; stored plates do not complete this goal. If it stops, hover over its panel status.
veio.onboarding.hint.3: Four plates produced! Use 2 plates + piston + crafting table to make an assembler. Place and power it; put the other 2 plates in its input. The goal requires a newly produced gear. Carry materials by hand for now.
veio.onboarding.hint.4: The workshop now needs 24 plates and 8 gears. Let us remove trips. Craft an extractor with 2 copper ingots + 1 iron ingot + piston. Place it ON copper ore and supply power. Keep the vein. It must actually extract copper.
veio.onboarding.hint.5: Extraction works! Feed the press with belts, arms, hoppers or a hired hauler. A player-stocked input buffer is allowed. Only actual transport deliveries and fresh press cycles count. Simple example: extractor > belt > press. Arms need power; haulers need food and access.
veio.onboarding.hint.6: The press is automatically supplied. Now store 4 plates made with that supply using belts, arms, hoppers, haulers or a mixture. Chests, barrels, hoppers, barns, silos and hauler post storage count. Worker cargo counts only after unloading. Old manually added plates do not count.
veio.onboarding.hint.7: Your transport automatically stored 4 plates! Reserve 24 plates and use another 16 for 8 gears. Hub: chest + gear + iron ingot + copper ingot. For its first order put plates in input 1 and gears in input 2; leave outputs clear. Reward: 64 belts + 32 cables.
veio.onboarding.hint.8: Workshop supplied! Collect the hub rewards. You learned power, cycles, flow and storage. Now stock 32 gears to open the workshop. One normal extractor feeds one press; two lines feed an assembler. Check power before expanding. /veiotutorial reiniciar restarts the exercises; books remain optional references.

veio.transport.title: Freight Guide
veio.transport.page.1:
Choose by purpose:

Pig: early cargo.
Horse: light and fast.
Donkey: heavier cargo.
Drone: short air route.
Rail: high volume.

Caravans need a road.
veio.transport.page.2:
Use the SAME DYE on two terminals of the same type. Color links the route; dye is kept.

Exactly two ends per color.

The card selects a numbered channel instead; 0 disables it.
veio.transport.page.3:
Sneak + product copies outgoing cargo. Left slots hold dispatch stock.

Right slots receive the other end's product. Use an item without sneaking to fix a manual receiving filter.

Empty hand opens the panel.
veio.transport.page.4:
Place a foreman desk and hauler post near machines and terminal. Hire and feed both.

The foreman plans the queue. The hauler fills dispatch and uses received goods in compatible machines.
veio.transport.page.5:
Hoppers link terminals and chest minecarts.

Separate loading from unloading, or alternate hoppers with redstone. Avoid pulling new cargo straight back out.

You define rails and stops.
veio.transport.page.6:
Up to 64 blocks and 16 items per flight. Power both ports.

Clear the direct path three blocks above them. Obstacles and unloaded chunks pause travel.

Sneak + wrench recalls the drone.
veio.transport.page.7:

Horse: tamed and saddled.
Donkey/mule: tamed with chest.
Pig: saddled.

Use a lead on the caravan terminal to assign it. The lead is kept.
veio.transport.page.8:

Horse: 16 items.
Donkey/mule: 64 items.
Wheat, apple or hay.

Carrot, potato, beetroot. No power.
veio.transport.page.9:
Caravans accept targets up to 512 blocks away. The animal really walks; delivery requires arrival.

Use a wide road without drops. Riding or leashing pauses its job.

Sneak + wrench recalls it.
veio.transport.page.10:
No destination, room or animal: cargo stays at the terminal.

Sneak + lead releases the animal and restores undelivered cargo if room allows.

No animal teleportation.
veio.transport.page.11:
Caravans need an active origin and animal. Unloading the origin pauses travel.

Delivery needs an active destination.

512-block range does not force world loading.
